title_en: Fall 2026 Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey: Period Extended to November 12
summary: Students enrolled in Fall 2026 undergraduate and graduate courses are asked to take part in the mid-semester course feedback survey. The survey period has been extended by one week and now runs from 29 October to 12 November 2026 (Thursday). Responses are submitted on the mySNU portal under Basic Information → Classes/Grades → Grades → Course Evaluation.
applies_to: Students enrolled in any undergraduate or graduate course offered in Fall 2026, except graduate 'Thesis Research' (논문연구) courses. Participation is encouraged; the notice does not state that it is mandatory.

dates.what: Mid-semester course feedback survey period (extended by one week)

conditions: The original end date of 5 November 2026 has been replaced by 12 November 2026.
Graduate 'Thesis Research' (논문연구) courses are not covered by the survey.
The two questions about online (non-face-to-face) classes need to be answered only if they apply to the course.
steps: Read the attached guide to the mid-semester course feedback survey program (this attachment was not read for this translation).
Log in to the mySNU portal and go to Basic Information (기본정보) → Classes/Grades (수업/성적) → Grades (성적) → Course Evaluation (강의평가).
For each course you are enrolled in, answer the four free-text questions (the two about online classes only if they apply) by Thursday 12 November 2026.
translation:
Fall 2026 Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey (Period Extended: until Thursday 11/12)

The period of the Fall 2026 Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey has been extended as shown below. We encourage all enrolled students to participate.

1. Survey period: 2026.10.29. (Thu) – 11.05. (Thu) [original period, replaced]
1. Survey period: 2026.10.29. (Thu) – 11.12. (Thu) ※ Extended by one week

2. How to participate: mySNU portal → Basic Information (기본정보) → Classes/Grades (수업/성적) → Grades (성적) → Course Evaluation (강의평가)

3. Courses covered: all courses offered at the undergraduate and graduate levels (excluding graduate 'Thesis Research' (논문연구) courses)

4. Survey questions: four free-text questions (the two questions on online classes are to be answered only if applicable)
○ Please describe anything particularly good or memorable about this course.
○ Please describe anything that could be improved in this course.
○ Please describe whether the online teaching methods (live video classes, lecture videos, documents, assignments, etc.) were suitable for the nature of the course.
○ Please describe your overall satisfaction with the online classes and anything that could be improved.

[Attachment] Guide to the Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey Program
Attached file (1): [Attachment] Guide to the Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey Program.pdf (153 KB) — the content of this attachment was not read.
